members.details: Asrar was born in Deoria, Uttar Pradesh. After completion of his schooling, he took admission at Aligarh Muslim University for his undergraduate education. He became very much interested about chemistry and he further continued his post-graduate education in Chemistry with specialization in inorganic in the Department of Chemistry at Aligarh Muslim University. As part of his master thesis work, he was working on synthesis of RNA-targeted Copper-based therapeutic drug entity. After completing M.Sc., he Joined the group to pursue his doctoral study in Spring 2020. Currently, he is working in the area of Asymmetric Catalysis and Metalloradical Chemistry. He loves to watch fiction drama and likes to play cricket.
members.name: Asrar Ahmad

members.details: His interest in organic synthesis developed in his undergraduate final semester 2019 where he had the opportunity to attend the workshop conducted by BARC, Mumbai. His postgraduate specialization was in organic chemistry from K.J.Somaiya College, Mumbai. His postgraduate project was based on molecular docking studies in association with IIT Bombay. He had also worked as a Subject Matter Expert with companies like Chegg India, Kunduz Technologies, Softusvista. He joined the group as a junior research fellow supported by SERB-SRG grant in monsoon 2021. Since August 2022, he joined the group as PhD student and working in the area of transition metal catalysed cascade reaction. He likes to spend his spare time playing basketball, listening to podcast and workout in gym.
members.name: Prashant B. Singh

members.currentPosition: PhD Student at the University of Illinois Chicago
members.details: Garvisha Mittal is an undergraduate student majoring in chemistry. She has always been interested in science since her school days and so decided to go for research in chemical sciences. She joined the group in monsoon 2020 as our student and currently working the area of photo-induced radical polymerisation. She experienced that there is no single approach that works for everyone, so she continues to educate herself on emerging scientific trends. If in one part of her brain runs science then in another runs literary arts. She is a great enthusiast of poetry and prose. She has received the honor of getting published in quite a few anthologies as a co-author. Other hobbies of hers include dancing, sketching, learning new languages and cooking. In the near future, she wants to see herself standing on a path of being a scientist and an author.
members.name: Garvisha Mittal

members.details: Lokesh Gupta was born and brought up in Raigarh, Chhattisgarh. He obtained his Bachelor's in chemistry and Master's in Organic Chemistry (honors) from Guru Ghasidas University (Central University), Bilaspur. After qualifying GATE in 2019, he joined the National Institute of Science Education and Research (NISER) as a JRF and worked on Transition metal-catalyzed C-H activation Chemistry. He also qualified CSIR-UGC JRF with AIR-94 in June 2022. In August 2022, he joined the group for the doctoral program and is currently working on Metalloradical chemistry. He loves to explore new places and teaching chemistry.
members.name: Lokesh Gupta

members.details: “A neutron walks into a bar and asks how much for a drink. The bartender replies, ‘For you, No charge’.” Chemistry is always fun until you realize it. He started to like chemistry from his secondary school until then it was just any other subject. After completion of his higher secondary education as Science major, he became very much fascinated about the science and decided to make career in Natural Science. Currently, he is pursuing his B.Sc. (Research) in Chemistry. He joined the group in monsoon 2021 and currently working in the area of “Total Synthesis of Alkaloids”. Well, he is a fitness freak too. In his spare time he likes to indulge in physical activities like running, playing Football, etc.
members.name: Abhay Dixit

members.details: Ajay was born & brought up in Nashik, Maharashtra, India. He has done his B. Sc & M. Sc in organic chemistry from H.PT Arts & R.Y.K Science College Nashik affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University in 2022. After completing his M.Sc, He joined the group at SNU Delhi NCR in August 2022. Currently, he is working on photochemistry, light-mediated organic transformation such as dehydrogenation, C-C bond cleavage reactions & HAT mediated radical cyclisation in the synthesis of natural products. In his spare time, he likes to go for a run, read (Marathi books), trek especially in Sahyadri Hills, Solo trips & Farming. He is a massive fan of MSD7 (Thala).
members.name: Ajay B. Shelke

members.details: V. Naga Malleswara Rao earned his postgraduate degree in organic chemistry from GITAM University, Visakhapatnam. His master's thesis focused on the "Synthesis and Antimicrobial Evaluation of Novel 1,3,4-Thiadiazoles and Their Schiff Bases and Azo Derivatives". Demonstrating academic excellence, he qualified the CSIR-NET (JRF) twice in June and December 2016, achieving AIR-123 and AIR-102, respectively. Additionally, he cleared GATE-2017 and the State Eligibility Test for Assistant Professor in 2016. Prior to joining Shiv Nadar Institution of Eminence, he gained 4.5 years of valuable experience in the Discovery and Process R&D department of the pharmaceutical industry. In Monsoon 2022, he joined the group as a Junior Research Fellow under a DST-SERB grant and subsequently enrolled for his Ph.D. in Monsoon 2023. Currently, his research explores Metal-Catalysed & Metal-Catalyst-Free Csp² (Aromatic)-Csp² (Alkyl) Coupling Reactions. Beyond his professional and academic pursuits, he enjoys watching science fiction movies and staying active through gym workouts.
members.name: V. Naga Malleswara Rao

members.details: Saumya Singh is an undergraduate student doing major in chemistry and minor in physics. She has always been passionate about solving the mystery of how the universe works and hence chose this field of study. She joined the group in spring 2022 and currently working in area of copper catalysed carbon-heteroatom bond formation reaction. She is always curious to learn new things. Her hobbies include reading novels, art and craft and playing sports
members.name: Saumya Singh

members.details: Arushi Phillips is a Ph.D. researcher in the Department of Chemistry at Shiv Nadar Institution of Eminence, having joined the program in 2025 under the supervision of Dr. Ajoy Kapat. She has completed B.Sc. (Hons.) and M.Sc. in Chemistry from Amity University, Noida, where she developed interest in organic chemistry, materials science, and synthetic methodology. Her current research focuses on synthetic organic chemistry, metalloradical catalysis, CO₂ utilization and organofluoride chemistry. She is an author and co-author of review articles and book chapters covering topics such as gold nanoparticles for cancer therapy, N-fluorobenzenesulfonimide (NFSI), fluorination strategies, and sustainable food-packaging materials. In addition to her research, she actively participates in scientific communication, academic conferences, and outreach activities.
members.name: Arushi Phillips

members.currentPosition: Summer Internship at Leibniz-Institute for Catalysis (LIKAT), Germany
members.details: Tiya Garg is currently pursuing her B.Sc Chemistry (Research) degree at Shiv Nadar Institution of Eminence. She is a second-year undergraduate student who joined Shiv Nadar Institution of Eminence (SNIoE's) Opportunities for Undergraduate Research (OUR) program in her 2nd year. As part of this initiative, she is currently engaged in a research project centred on the synthesis of diene compounds using a transition metal-free approach. Tiya has a strong aptitude for scientific research, marked by her hardworking nature, critical thinking abilities, and inquisitive mindset. Her interest in organic chemistry was sparked through hands-on laboratory work and a curiosity-driven approach to learning, which continues to fuel her desire to understand and explore complex reaction mechanisms. In addition to her academic and research commitments, Tiya actively participates in a variety of extracurricular activities. She is a trained dancer, enjoys playing basketball, and finds joy in reading a wide range of novels.
members.name: Tiya Garg

members.details: Umashankar was born in Dhamtari, Chhattisgarh. He is currently pursuing his masters from Guru Ghasidas Central University Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. His interest in organic chemistry was developed during his under graduate study. He is very much curious to know the reaction mechanism and he is very much fascinated about the chemistry of alkaloids and their use in pharmaceutical industry. He joined the group in summer 2022 as research intern supported by SRG grant from DST-SERB. During his free times, he used to watch movie listening song, playing football, badminton. He likes to travel and likes to explore new things.
members.name: Umashankar

members.currentPosition: Preparing for SSC CGL; qualified CDS and AFCAT round 1 (twice each), State Rank 76 in UP B.Ed. entrance
members.details: Science is the panacea for curiosity, and chemistry is the panacea for hope and constructive change. She became more interested in science prior to grade 10. From securing 1st place in inter-house science quizzes to getting outstanding marks in science in the 10th-grade CBSE board examination, science has always found a special place in her mind and heart. She joined SNU in the 2020 monsoon and became part of the Kapat Group in 2023. Her research project focused on "Efficient Synthesis of N-containing Heterocycles via Lewis Acid Catalysed Triple Bond Cleavage of Ynones" for a possible therapeutic drug for Hepatitis B. The research was successfully published in Chemistry—A European Journal, titled "Efficient Access of Heterocycles Utilizing Inherent Carbodicationic Reactivity of Ynone via Lewis Acid-Catalysed C-C Triple Bond Cleavage." Besides chemistry, she loves sketching, drawing, craftwork, and gardening.
members.name: Kumari Indu

members.currentPosition: M.Sc. Student at University of KU Leuven
members.details: Mansi is an undergraduate student majoring in Chemistry and minoring in English. Born and brought up in an army household, she has travelled all across the country. Mansi has always been interested in chemistry, and her passion for organic chemistry motivated her to join Dr. Ajoy Kapat's research group as an OUR student and commence her research journey in 2022. She explored metalloradical chemistry during both her OUR projects, and she was working on Lewis acid catalysed cascade reaction during her final year undergraduate thesis work. She hopes to learn more about organic synthesis in the future and build a career in research. In her free time, she likes to indulge in photography, painting and reading novels.
members.name: Mansi Bhattacharya

members.details: Manya Singh, born and brought up in New Delhi, completed her schooling at KR Mangalam World School, GK2. She joined the group in 2022 as an OUR student under the mentorship of Dr Ajoy Kapat, beginning her research journey with the synthesis of a library of compounds for evaluating their anti-tuberculosis activity. Building on her initial success, she continued this project in 2023, further expanding the scope of her work. In 2024, she undertook her final-year undergraduate thesis, focusing on the design and synthesis of small molecules targeting ccc-DNA for the treatment of chronic HBV infection. Manya's deep curiosity has been the driving force behind her passion for science, leading her to explore the dynamic overlap between chemistry and biology. Beyond academics, she enjoys reading and writing, listening to music, and playing different sports.
members.name: Manya Singh

members.currentPosition: PhD Student at California Institute of Technology, USA
members.details: Shreya Sivaramakrishnan was pursuing her B.Sc. (Research) Chemistry, with a passion for scientific inquiry and sustainable development. Her research journey began in high school, leading her to explore various facets of chemistry, including electrochemistry, computational biology, and chemical biology, through multiple internships and projects. She was working on metalloradical-based reduction reactions as an OUR student. She was working on trifluoromethylation during her final thesis work. Believing that "Research is not just about finding answers; it's about asking the right questions that lead to a sustainable future", she strives to consistently equip herself with new research skills and learn new things. Beyond academia, she enjoys watching movies, connecting with people, and finding solace in nature treks and photography.
members.name: Shreya Sivaramakrishnan
